root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause per BA: structural absence of a sanctioned deploy mechanism made in-place install-path edits operationally easier than source-first edits, which guaranteed the anti-pattern (edit-the-installed-artifact) recurs. Dev's three-layer close-out addresses ALL three causal levers: (1) reverse-sync orphaned bytes back to source so source repo is no longer stale; (2) add deploy script with sha256 round-trip so the next install-path edit fails loudly on next deploy; (3) update doc + CLAUDE.md so the convention is discoverable. Architect arch-prop-2 (launch-time drift check) and arch-prop-3 (preinstall guard) are explicitly deferred per BA scope — out of THIS cycle's user-need path; recorded as Could Have C1/C2 for future cycles. The minimum-safest-precise scope choice is intentional per spec-20260503-091826 §5.1.
